Item.Description: Shipment by Shipment. The claim amount is calculated from the Import documents which directly relates to the Export consignment.
Representative Shipment. Covers a variety of assessment methods. Uses a representative Shipment rather than the actual Import Shipment.

Imputation. Claimants who can't obtain Import documents from their suppliers can “Impute” a Customs value based on 30% of the price from the supplier. Formulas are set out in the Customs Regs. Only to be used for fully Imported goods purchased in Australia by the Exporter (i.e. Goods that have not been further processed in Australia). All method C claims are routed ‘Red-Line’.
Other Method. Another method suggested by the Claimant.
